ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2024-10-01..2025-09-30) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

share_issuance.basis: 4/4 quarters covered: the nine-month year-to-date fact 2025-10-01..2026-06-30 = 13.0M (ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock, filed 2026-07-31) + the filed quarters 2025-09-30

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters covered: the nine-month year-to-date fact 2025-10-01..2026-06-30 = 13.0M (ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock, filed 2026-07-31) + the filed quarters 2025-09-30); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

notes: split 3 tagged at 2013-09-30: facts filed before 2013-07-29 are on the pre-split basis — the diluted share count for the period ended 2012-06-30 was re-filed ×3.00 on 2013-07-29 (last filed on the old basis 2012-07-30)

annual_dps: FY DPS for the period ended 2011-09-30 is filed as 1 (10-K filed 2011-11-15, 10-K filed 2012-11-15) and as 0.33 (10-K filed 2013-11-12) — restated for the 3-for-1 split effective 2013-09-30 (first filed on the new basis 2013-07-29); 0.33 used (the latest filing on the new share basis, CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared)

annual_dps: FY DPS for the period ended 2012-09-30 is filed as 3.08 (10-K filed 2012-11-15) and as 1.03 (10-K filed 2013-11-12, 10-K filed 2014-11-12) — restated for the 3-for-1 split effective 2013-09-30 (first filed on the new basis 2013-07-29); 1.03 used (the latest filing on the new share basis, CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared)

quarterly DPS (declared): 1 quarter(s) filed at different values on the same share basis (2022-06-30: 0.29 (filed 2023-07-28) used, not 0.3 (filed 2024-01-29) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide)) — later 10-Ks and comparatives sometimes tag a year-to-date or annual value with a three-month context

split adjustment (declared DPS): 16 facts for periods ending 2007-09-30..2012-03-31 were last filed before the 3-for-1 split effective 2013-09-30 (first filed on the new basis 2013-07-29) and are divided by the filed ratio (StockholdersEquityNoteStockSplitConversionRatio1) to today's share basis

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (184 days between 2025-06-30 and 2025-12-31) — FY2025 DPS 1.28 + the quarters since (2025-12-31: 0.33, 2026-03-31: 0.33, 2026-06-30: 0.33) − the same quarters a year earlier (2024-12-31: 0.32, 2025-03-31: 0.32, 2025-06-30: 0.32)

share_issuance_ttm: the nine-month year-to-date fact 2025-10-01..2026-06-30 = 13.0M (ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock, filed 2026-07-31) + the filed quarters 2025-09-30 — the four quarters are covered by filed facts although not every quarter is filed on its own
